packageRules.description: neat-core is a sibling path dependency; the Auto Format workflow already runs `cargo update -p neat-core` on every PR, so Renovate must not fight it.

Internal stSoftwareAU code ships with no embargo (Issue #1613 classification). null is Renovate's documented no-embargo value; the schema types minimumReleaseAge as string|null, so "0" and false are both invalid.
